scope: readScene (X3D) and importBundle (experiment ZIP) under hostile input; jsdom DOMParser stands in for the browser parser.

checks.name: XXE: external entity in an internal DTD subset is refused before parsing
entity expansion ("billion laughs") is refused before parsing, in well under a second
oversized scene text (>200 000 characters) is refused before parsing
executable and external-content nodes are refused (Script, Inline, ExternProtoDeclare, ProtoInstance, Anchor, ImageTexture)
giant meshes are outside the profile: no mesh geometry nodes are accepted
event-handler and url attributes are refused on allowed nodes
non-finite and out-of-range physical values are refused (NaN, Infinity, 1e308, negative mass)
prototype pollution through the embedded manifest JSON has no effect
URL-bearing fields not literally named "url" (Background backUrl …) pass the filter, but are dropped: import returns only the recipe and target and the scene is regenerated canonically
deeply nested allowed nodes (5 000 Transforms within the size limit) parse; bounded only by the 200 KB cap
packages over 2 MB are refused before unzipping
honest ZIP bomb: a member declaring >5 MB uncompressed is refused before inflating
many members whose declared sizes total >12 MB are refused before inflating
path-traversal member names are never written: import is in-memory and reads three fixed members only
MJCF <include>, plugins and extra assets in the package are refused: mjcf/model.xml must equal the MJCF regenerated from the recipe
manifest and scene that disagree are refused (no silent preference for either)
the scene inside a package goes through the same X3D filter (Script refused)
lying ZIP: a member whose headers under-declare its size passes the pre-check and is fully inflated before JSZip notices the mismatch

details.outcome: rejected: Bug : uncompressed data size mismatch
details.worstCaseNote: deflate tops out near 1032:1, so a 2 MB package can inflate to roughly 2 GB before rejection
